## Required Checks

- [ ] The PR stays inside the current local Git project.
- [ ] The PR preserves A-share-only guardrails where applicable.
- [ ] The PR does not introduce `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
- [ ] The PR does not add live trading or broker auto-submit behavior.
- [ ] Backend compile check passed.
- [ ] Frontend build passed.
- [ ] Automated smoke test passed.
- [ ] Targeted acceptance tests for this PR passed.

Record risk, rollout, and rollback notes here.
